shots.full: The same bare brick back room and the same five men in dark suits as the first reference image, where they sit and stand round the table with their whisky. In place of the old cast-iron press, the modern sheet-fed banknote press from the second reference image: long cream and grey steel panels, pale blue guards, an aluminium step platform, fills the right of the room. At its delivery end a waist-high stack of freshly printed uncut sheets of purple twenty-pound notes sits on a pallet, the top sheet seen at a slant. Camera low in the corner, the edge of the steel platform out of focus in the right foreground. Light: one warm bare bulb over the table, cold white fluorescent tubes over the press, the green glow of a fire-exit sign. Unretouched 35mm film still, rich saturated colour, fine grain. 16:9. Thanks.

The same man, pose, expression, brick room, table, whisky glass, camera and light as the first reference image. Behind him, in place of the old cast-iron press, stands the modern sheet-fed banknote press from the second reference image: long cream and grey steel panels, pale blue guards, an aluminium step platform, soft in the background, a stack of printed sheets of purple twenty-pound notes on its delivery pallet. A brick of new purple twenty-pound notes in a paper band lies on the table by his glass, seen at a slant. Cold white fluorescent light on the press behind, the warm bulb on him. Unretouched 35mm film still, rich saturated colour, fine grain. 16:9. Thanks.

The same two men, their toast and grins, the brick room, the table, the glasses, camera and light as the first reference image. Behind them, in place of the old cast-iron press, stands the modern sheet-fed banknote press from the second reference image: long cream and grey steel panels, pale blue guards, an aluminium step platform, soft in the background, stacks of printed sheets of purple twenty-pound notes on its delivery pallet. Bricks of new notes in paper bands on the table, seen at a slant. Cold white fluorescent light on the press behind, the warm bulb on them. Unretouched 35mm film still, rich saturated colour, fine grain. 16:9. Thanks.
